patthana23.44:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.44:2.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.44:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekavīsa. nasanidassanattika napītittike sanidassanattika pītittikaṃ
